defs.def: a separate section of a book, usually with a number or title （书的）章，篇，回

ex.s: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) provides teachers, students and staff with access to books that are checked out or not owned by our own libraries, as well as digitized copies of articles and book chapters from our collection.
ex.t: 馆际互借（ILL）为教师、学生和工作人员提供借阅已借出或本馆未收藏的图书的渠道，以及本馆收藏的文章和书籍章节的数字副本。

ex.s: For an article or book chapter, you will be notified by email when it is available.
ex.t: 对于文章或书籍章节，当其可用时，你会收到电子邮件通知。

ex.s: To obtain the article or chapter, click on the link provided in the email and log into your ILL account.
ex.t: 要获取该文章或章节，请点击邮件中提供的链接并登录你的馆际互借账户。

ex.s: Library Type Loan Cost Article/Chapter Cost
ex.t: 图书馆类型 借阅费用 文章/章节费用

ex.s: If you want to turn over a new leaf, though, one top tip is that it helps to choose a significant date that signals the start of a new “chapter”.
ex.t: 不过，如果你想重新开始，一个顶级建议是：选择一个象征新“章节”开始的重要日期会很有帮助。

ex.s: Elizabeth Sims analyzes the final chapters of five great novels to see what key points they include and how you can adapt them for your work.
ex.t: 伊丽莎白·西姆斯分析了五部伟大小说的最后章节，看看它们包含哪些要点，以及你如何将其改编运用到自己的作品中。

ex.s: In the final chapter of part one, I’ll guide you through carrying out your own digital declutter.
ex.t: 在第一部分的最后一章，我将指导你完成自己的数字清理。

ex.s: Each chapter concludes with a collection of practices, which are designed to help you act on the big ideas of the chapter.
ex.t: 每一章都以一系列实践练习收尾，这些练习旨在帮助你将本章的重要理念付诸行动。

ex.s: What is presented in the final chapter of part one?
ex.t: 第一部分的最后一章介绍了什么内容？

ex.s: ---                 .I'm still reading the last chapter.
ex.t: ---                 .我还在读最后一章。

ex.s: I quickly graduated from typical children’s books to ones with fewer pictures and longer chapters.
ex.t: 我很快就从典型的儿童读物过渡到图片较少、章节较长的书。

ex.s: In this part adapted from a chapter of the book, Aronnax describes the experience of walking on the sea bed… 1 And now, how can I look back upon the impression left upon me by that walk under the waters?
ex.t: 在本部分改编自本书的一章，阿龙纳斯描述了在海床上行走的经历…… 1现在，我如何回顾在水下行走给我留下的印象？

ex.s: Even when serving in the US Army during the Second World War, he carried six chapters of The Catcher in the Rye with him and worked on the novel throughout his war service.
ex.t: 即使在二战期间服役于美国陆军时，他也随身带着《麦田里的守望者》的六章手稿，在整个服役期间都在创作这部小说。

ex.s: This often appears at the beginning of a story, or a chapter, and helps the reader develop expectations about the coming events in a story.
ex.t: 这通常出现在故事的开头或章节中，帮助读者对故事中即将发生的事件产生期望。

ex.s: Ideally a history would bring together texts and objects, and some chapters of this book are able to do just that, but in many cases we simply can’t.
ex.t: 理想情况下，历史会把文本和实物结合起来，本书的一些章节能够做到这一点，但在许多情况下我们根本做不到。

ex.s: In the former case you may be able to read a chapter.
ex.t: 在前一种情况下，你可能能读一章。

defs.def: a period of time in a person's life or in history （人生或历史的）时期，时代，篇章

ex.s: Sitting at the table, making my mini sandwich, I realised I was ready for our next chapter.
ex.t: 坐在桌前做我的迷你三明治时，我意识到我已经为我们的下一个篇章做好了准备。

ex.s: Morgan 20, Florida, the US People say that 18 marks a new chapter in our lives, and that we should become more independent.
ex.t: 摩根20 ，佛罗里达，美国人民说， 18标志着我们生活的新篇章，我们应该变得更加独立。

ex.s: A New Chapter The day I heard that the Rainbow Bookstore was closing after 50 years of business, I was heartbroken.
ex.t: 新篇章听说彩虹书店开业50年后关门的那天，我心碎了。

ex.s: Our life story is something that starts coming together in our teenage years, when we begin to organise our lives into chapters around key events or life changes, and begin to see ourselves as both the central character and, to a varying extent, the story’s author.
ex.t: 我们的人生故事在青少年时期开始成形，那时我们开始把生活围绕关键事件或人生变化整理成一个个章节，并开始把自己视为故事的中心人物，并且在不同程度上也视为这个故事的创作者。
